title: D-6 independent fixture suite and notice RPC
executor: claude senior-tester subagent (fixtures) + claude backend-developer subagent (notice RPC), file-disjoint, parallel (decision #66)

fixtures.setup: Real `git init` temp workspaces under mkdtemp, os.homedir mocked to a temp home. The reconciler is a fixture double that does real file work: git-tracked copies are kept as git-tracked, untracked copies are deleted, the home fragment entry is removed from the temp ~/.claude.json, and one copy can fail once.
fixtures.retired1Removed2: Run 1 incomplete {retired 1, removed 1, kept 0, onDisk 0}: w1 done, w2 copy failed (failedPaths, no completedAt). Run 2 completed {1,2,0,0}: only w2 reconciled again (w1 1 call, w2 2 calls), w1 timestamp unchanged. Run 3 already-completed, no new reconcile calls.
fixtures.mixedFragments: Run 1 {1,2,1,0}: the shared home fragment counts once across two workspaces; tracked .cursor/rules copy kept as git-tracked. After retry {1,3,1,0}; home fragment timestamp and kept reason unchanged; hand-added `handmade` entry in ~/.claude.json and handmade/SKILL.md preserved and never in the ledger.
fixtures.notice: readNotice null with no ledger and while incomplete; non-null after completion; retired-only run {1,0,0,0}; identical across reads and new instances; dismissNotice writes ISO noticeSeenAt, later reads null (also new instance); later run already-completed; second dismiss leaves noticeSeenAt unchanged; dismiss with no ledger returns false.
tests: ends retired 1 / removed 2 across two git workspaces after a partial failure and retry
keeps mixed fragments across the retry: nothing lost, nothing recounted, hand-added entries preserved
readNotice > is null before any run, and null while the migration is incomplete
readNotice > shows a retired-only state, persists it until dismissal and records seenAt
readNotice > dismissNotice reports false when no ledger exists

rpc.class: InstallScopeNoticeRpcHandlers (@injectable; injects TOKENS.LOGGER, TOKENS.RPC_HANDLER, InstallScopeMigrationService by class).
rpc.methods: harness:get-install-migration-notice -> { notice: InstallMigrationNotice | null } from readNotice(); harness:dismiss-install-migration-notice -> { success } from dismissNotice(). Both validate params with z.object({}).strict() -> RpcUserError INVALID_PARAMS fixed copy. Dismiss rejection -> logger.error with the real Error + RpcUserError(INSTALL_MIGRATION_NOTICE_DISMISS_ERROR, PERSISTENCE_UNAVAILABLE); no fs text or path reaches the caller.
rpc.mapping: ledger removed -> wire deleted; kept rows -> paths only; onDisk itemId prefix mcp: -> mcp-home-entry, else skills-sh-root. The service produces onDisk only for skills.sh roots today (install-scope-migration.service.ts:682).
rpc.methodsTyping: METHODS satisfies readonly (keyof InstallScopeRpcMethodRegistry)[] (decision #67); the shared registry join is Batch 35.
tests: declares exactly the two notice methods
returns a null notice when no ledger exists yet
returns a null notice before the migration completed
returns the persisted notice mapped to the shared contract
refuses non-empty params with fixed copy
persists noticeSeenAt and hides the notice afterwards
reports success false when there is no ledger to dismiss
refuses non-empty params before touching the ledger
maps a real ledger failure to fixed copy and logs the cause
never forwards raw fs error text or paths to the caller
